#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Find a probability distribution P over a vocabulary of size V = 150,000 such that:
  KL(P||U) = 10.0  (forward KL, within 0.001)
  KL(U||P) = 10.0  (backward KL, within 0.001)
where U is the uniform distribution.

Strategy: parametrize P with two shape parameters:
  p[0]   = s                      (a single high-probability token)
  p[i]   = (1-s) * e^{-theta(i-1)} / Z,  i = 1..V-1   (geometric tail)
Two parameters, two constraints -> solve with scipy least_squares.
"""
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

V = 150000
TARGET = 10.0
TOL = 1e-3


def build_p(s, theta):
    """p[0] = s; p[1:] = (1-s) * truncated geometric(theta), exactly normalized."""
    i = np.arange(1, V, dtype=np.float64)
    w = np.exp(-theta * (i - 1.0))
    w /= w.sum()          # exact normalization of the truncated tail
    p = np.empty(V, dtype=np.float64)
    p[0] = s
    p[1:] = (1.0 - s) * w
    return p


def kl_pair(p):
    U = 1.0 / V
    kl_fwd = float(np.sum(p * np.log(p / U)))   # KL(P||U)
    kl_bwd = float(np.sum(U * np.log(U / p)))   # KL(U||P)
    return kl_fwd, kl_bwd


def residuals(v):
    s, theta = v
    p = build_p(s, theta)
    f, b = kl_pair(p)
    return [f - TARGET, b - TARGET]


sol = least_squares(residuals, x0=[0.86, 1.5e-4],
                    bounds=([1e-6, 1e-6], [1.0 - 1e-12, 1e-1]),
                    xtol=1e-16, ftol=1e-16, gtol=1e-16)
s, theta = sol.x
print(f"optimizer: success={sol.success}  cost={sol.cost:.3e}  nfev={sol.nfev}")
print(f"s = {s:.12f}   theta = {theta:.12e}")

p = build_p(s, theta)
f, b = kl_pair(p)
print(f"KL(P||U) = {f:.10f}   |diff| = {abs(f-TARGET):.3e}")
print(f"KL(U||P) = {b:.10f}   |diff| = {abs(b-TARGET):.3e}")
print(f"shape={p.shape} dtype={p.dtype}")
print(f"sum(p) = {p.sum():.17f}   min(p) = {p.min():.6e}   max(p) = {p.max():.6f}")

assert p.shape == (V,)
assert np.all(p > 0.0), "all probabilities must be strictly positive"
assert abs(p.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-9, "must be normalized"
assert abs(f - TARGET) <= TOL, f"forward KL off by {abs(f-TARGET)}"
assert abs(b - TARGET) <= TOL, f"backward KL off by {abs(b-TARGET)}"

np.save('/app/dist.npy', p)
print("SAVED /app/dist.npy")
EOF
